card.name: Words that set a cap or limit
card.fires_on: The word "limit" itself, and words inside phrases that set a maximum, such as "in any 24-hour period", "any one muscle" or "per candidate". It fires where the text is about to state or has just stated a cap.

modes.label: The word limit
modes.description: The word limit or limits right after a word like set, bag or a.
modes.example: has set a<< limit>> for expenditure as Rs 25 lak

modes.label: Inside cap phrases
modes.description: Words within a phrase that sets a maximum amount over a period or unit.
modes.example: The maximum daily dose is 10 mg in any 24-hour<< period>>.

card.writes: It boosts the word limit and its variants as the next word.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is setting a maximum or cap on something.
